ex.en: The sample is not pure enough.
ex.zh: 這個樣本不夠純。

ex.en: The doctor took a blood sample.
ex.zh: 醫生抽了血液樣本。

sample.en: a small part taken from a larger group to study or test

ex.en: Would you show us some samples of your work?
ex.zh: 可以讓我們看看你的作品樣本嗎？

ex.en: The store was giving out free samples of cheese.
ex.zh: 那家店在發送起司試吃品。

sample.en: a small amount of a product that shows what the rest is like

ex.en: You can sample local food at the night market.
ex.zh: 你可以在夜市品嚐當地美食。

ex.en: We sampled five kinds of tea.
ex.zh: 我們試喝了五種茶。

sample.en: to try a small amount of food or drink to see what it is like

ex.en: Don't forget to save your work.
ex.zh: 別忘了存檔。

ex.en: Save the file before you close the program.
ex.zh: 關閉程式前先存檔。

save.en: to keep information on a computer so you can use it later

ex.en: I am saving money in order to study abroad.
ex.zh: 我在存錢準備出國留學。

ex.en: I am working to save for my college tuition.
ex.zh: 我打工是為了存大學學費。

save.en: to keep money to use later instead of spending it

ex.en: Computers save us a lot of time and trouble.
ex.zh: 電腦幫我們省了很多時間和麻煩。

ex.en: The bridge saved us a lot of time.
ex.zh: 那座橋幫我們省了很多時間。

save.en: to use less time or money

ex.en: The doctor saved her life.
ex.zh: 醫生救了她的命。

ex.en: He saved a child from drowning.
ex.zh: 他救了一個差點溺水的孩子。

save.en: to keep someone or something safe from harm or death

ex.en: In my sandwich there is meat, cheese and tomatoes.
ex.zh: 我的三明治裡有肉、起司和番茄。

ex.en: I think you should eat a ham sandwich.
ex.zh: 我覺得你應該吃個火腿三明治。

ex.en: What kind of sandwich do you want?
ex.zh: 你想要哪一種三明治？

sandwich.en: two pieces of bread with meat, cheese or vegetables between them

ex.en: Mongolia is sandwiched between Russia and China.
ex.zh: 蒙古夾在俄羅斯和中國之間。

ex.en: My meeting is sandwiched between two calls.
ex.zh: 我的會議被夾在兩通電話之間。

sandwich.en: to put or be placed tightly between two other things

ex.en: My mother forgot to add salt to the salad.
ex.zh: 我媽媽忘了在沙拉裡加鹽。

ex.en: You have the choice of soup or salad.
ex.zh: 你可以選湯或沙拉。

ex.en: Tom is in the kitchen making a salad.
ex.zh: 湯姆正在廚房做沙拉。

salad.en: a cold dish of mixed raw vegetables

ex.en: The salesperson showed us several models.
ex.zh: 店員給我們看了好幾種型號。

ex.en: She is the top salesperson in our company.
ex.zh: 她是我們公司業績最好的業務員。

salesperson.en: a person whose job is to sell things

ex.en: The boat was piloted safely into harbor.
ex.zh: 船被安全地引導進港。

ex.en: When you safely arrive at your destination, don't forget to call me.
ex.zh: 你平安抵達目的地後，別忘了打電話給我。

ex.en: The fishing boat which had been missing returned safely to port.
ex.zh: 失蹤的漁船平安回港了。

safely.en: in a way that avoids danger or harm

ex.en: It may safely be said that he will never succeed in business.
ex.zh: 可以肯定地說，他做生意永遠不會成功。

ex.en: I can safely say this is the best hotel in town.
ex.zh: 我可以肯定地說，這是城裡最好的飯店。

safely.en: in a way that is sure to be true

satisfactory.zh: 令人滿意的、符合要求的

ex.en: The results of the research were quite satisfactory.
ex.zh: 研究結果相當令人滿意。

ex.en: The explanation is by no means satisfactory.
ex.zh: 這個解釋一點都不令人滿意。

ex.en: His work performance is satisfactory.
ex.zh: 他的工作表現令人滿意。

satisfactory.en: good enough to meet what is needed

ex.en: He makes a living as a salesman.
ex.zh: 他以當推銷員維生。

ex.en: I was mistaken for a salesman.
ex.zh: 我被誤認為是推銷員。

ex.en: The customer and the salesman spoke for two hours on the phone.
ex.zh: 顧客和業務員講了兩個小時的電話。

salesman.en: a man whose job is to sell things

ex.en: She likes to go to the sauna.
ex.zh: 她喜歡去洗三溫暖。

ex.en: The hotel has a gym and a sauna.
ex.zh: 這家飯店有健身房和三溫暖。

sauna.en: a small hot room where people sit to sweat and relax

salespeople.zh: 銷售人員、業務員、店員（salesperson 的複數）

ex.en: Our salespeople visit clients every week.
ex.zh: 我們的業務員每週拜訪客戶。

ex.en: The salespeople in that store were very helpful.
ex.zh: 那家店的店員很熱心。

salespeople.en: people whose job is to sell things

ex.en: I have an appointment at the hair salon on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我星期六在髮廊有預約。

ex.en: She opened a beauty salon downtown.
ex.zh: 她在市中心開了一家美容院。

salon.en: a shop where people get their hair cut or beauty care

ex.en: It's gravity that makes satellites move around the Earth.
ex.zh: 讓衛星繞著地球運轉的是重力。

ex.en: A satellite was launched in Russia last year.
ex.zh: 俄羅斯去年發射了一顆衛星。

ex.en: Choose a suitable satellite image as the base map.
ex.zh: 選一張合適的衛星影像當作底圖。

satellite.en: an object that moves around the earth in space, either natural or made by people

ex.en: He carried a sack of rice on his back.
ex.zh: 他背著一袋米。

ex.en: We bought two sacks of potatoes.
ex.zh: 我們買了兩大袋馬鈴薯。

sack.en: a large strong bag for carrying heavy things

ex.en: My father has been sacked.
ex.zh: 我爸爸被開除了。

ex.en: I was sacked yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天被開除了。

sack.en: to fire someone from a job (informal)

sack.zh: hit the sack：上床睡覺（口語）

ex.en: I need to hit the sack.
ex.zh: 我該去睡了。

ex.en: It's time to hit the sack.
ex.zh: 該睡覺了。

ex.en: Would it be ethical to sacrifice one person to save many?
ex.zh: 犧牲一個人去救很多人，這樣合乎道德嗎？

ex.en: She sacrificed her weekends to finish the project.
ex.zh: 她犧牲週末來完成這個專案。

sacrifice.en: to give up something you value for a person or a goal

ex.en: Parents make many sacrifices for their children.
ex.zh: 父母為孩子做出許多犧牲。

ex.en: Working abroad was a big sacrifice for my family.
ex.zh: 到國外工作對我們家來說是很大的犧牲。

sacrifice.en: something valuable that you give up for a person or a goal

ex.en: We need safeguards against data loss.
ex.zh: 我們需要防止資料遺失的保護措施。

ex.en: The new law includes safeguards for workers.
ex.zh: 新法律包含保障勞工的措施。

safeguard.en: something that protects against harm or loss

ex.en: We must safeguard our customers' data.
ex.zh: 我們必須保護客戶的資料。

ex.en: The policy is designed to safeguard employees' rights.
ex.zh: 這項政策是為了維護員工的權益。

safeguard.en: to keep something safe from harm or loss

ex.en: We managed to salvage the deal at the last minute.
ex.zh: 我們在最後一刻挽救了這筆交易。

ex.en: Can you salvage any files from the broken laptop?
ex.zh: 你能從壞掉的筆電救回任何檔案嗎？

salvage.en: to save something from being lost or destroyed

ex.en: The salvage operation took three weeks.
ex.zh: 打撈作業花了三個星期。

ex.en: Salvage crews recovered the ship's cargo.
ex.zh: 打撈人員找回了船上的貨物。

salvage.en: the act of saving a ship or its goods after an accident

sadly.zh: 遺憾的是、可惜（常放句首）

ex.en: Sadly, I have to wake up early every day.
ex.zh: 可惜的是，我每天都得早起。

ex.en: Sadly, most young people speak dialect only rarely.
ex.zh: 遺憾的是，大多數年輕人已經很少說方言了。

ex.en: The doctors did all they could to control Tom's disease but, sadly, to no avail.
ex.zh: 醫生們盡力控制湯姆的病情，但可惜還是沒有用。

sadly.en: used to show that you feel sorry about a fact

ex.en: "He used to love me," she answered sadly.
ex.zh: 「他以前很愛我。」她傷心地回答。

ex.en: Tom looked sadly at the empty house.
ex.zh: 湯姆悲傷地看著那間空房子。

ex.en: Savers are earning very little interest these days.
ex.zh: 最近存款人賺到的利息很少。

ex.en: I'm a good saver; I put money aside every month.
ex.zh: 我很會存錢，每個月都會存一筆。

saver.en: a person who keeps money in a bank for the future

ex.en: This dishwasher is a real time saver.
ex.zh: 這台洗碗機真的很省時間。

ex.en: The app is a money saver for travelers.
ex.zh: 這個 App 能幫旅客省錢。

saver.en: something that helps you use less time or money

ex.en: Whatever I do, she says I can do better.
ex.zh: 不管我做什麼，她都說我可以做得更好。

ex.en: Whatever you said to him made him feel better.
ex.zh: 你跟他說的話讓他好受多了。

ex.en: The sign says "No parking."
ex.zh: 告示上寫著「禁止停車」。

ex.en: What does the email say?
ex.zh: 那封電子郵件寫了什麼？

ex.en: Let's meet at, say, three o'clock?
ex.zh: 我們約，比方說三點，好嗎？

ex.en: Say you lost your job. What would you do?
ex.zh: 假設你失業了，你會怎麼做？

say.en: to suppose or give as an example, often a rough guess

ex.en: Employees should have a say in the decision.
ex.zh: 員工應該對這個決定有發言權。

ex.en: I had no say in the matter.
ex.zh: 這件事我沒有決定權。

say.en: the right to give your opinion and help make a decision

say.zh: it goes without saying：不用說、理所當然

ex.en: It goes without saying that money cannot buy happiness.
ex.zh: 不用說，錢買不到幸福。

ex.en: It goes without saying that safety comes first.
ex.zh: 不用說，安全第一。

say.en: used to show that something is so clear that nobody needs to mention it

ex.en: You continue making the same mistakes time after time.
ex.zh: 你一再犯同樣的錯誤。

ex.en: This is the same pen that I lost yesterday.
ex.zh: 這就是我昨天弄丟的那支筆。

ex.en: I want the same jacket as you are wearing.
ex.zh: 我想要一件跟你身上那件一樣的外套。

same.en: not different, or being the one already talked about

ex.en: If I were you, I would do the same.
ex.zh: 如果我是你，我也會這麼做。

ex.en: I'll have the same, please.
ex.zh: 請給我一樣的。

same.en: the thing that was already mentioned

ex.en: You should keep your valuables in a safe place.
ex.zh: 你應該把貴重物品放在安全的地方。

ex.en: I suggest we move to a safer location.
ex.zh: 我建議我們換到更安全的地方。

ex.en: She felt much safer once she’d put her helmet on.
ex.zh: 她一戴上安全帽，就覺得安全多了。

safe.en: not in danger, or not likely to cause harm

ex.en: The papers that were in the safe are gone.
ex.zh: 放在保險箱裡的文件不見了。

ex.en: Please keep your passport in the hotel safe.
ex.zh: 請把護照放在飯店的保險箱裡。

safe.en: a strong metal box with a lock, used to keep money and valuable things

ex.en: On the whole I am satisfied with the result.
ex.zh: 整體來說，我對這個結果很滿意。

ex.en: I am sorry, we are unable to satisfy your demand.
ex.zh: 很抱歉，我們無法滿足您的要求。

ex.en: It is difficult to satisfy everyone.
ex.zh: 要讓每個人都滿意很難。

satisfy.en: to make someone happy by giving them what they want or need

ex.en: The product must satisfy all safety standards.
ex.zh: 這項產品必須符合所有安全標準。

ex.en: Applicants must satisfy the following requirements.
ex.zh: 申請人必須符合下列條件。

satisfy.en: to be good enough to meet a need or rule

ex.en: When she was reading the letter, she looked sad.
ex.zh: 她讀信時看起來很難過。

ex.en: She got really sad because of what he said.
ex.zh: 她因為他說的話而非常傷心。

ex.en: One night he came home very tired and sad.
ex.zh: 有天晚上他回到家，又累又難過。

ex.en: It's sad that the old bookstore is closing.
ex.zh: 那家老書店要關門了，真令人遺憾。

ex.en: The sad truth is that we can't afford it.
ex.zh: 令人遺憾的事實是我們負擔不起。

sad.en: making you feel sorry or disappointed

ex.en: Columbus sailed farther west to look for a new continent.
ex.zh: 哥倫布往更遠的西方航行，尋找新大陸。

ex.en: They sailed along the west coast of Africa.
ex.zh: 他們沿著非洲西岸航行。

ex.en: Tom is teaching me to how to sail.
ex.zh: 湯姆正在教我怎麼駕駛帆船。

sail.en: to travel on water in a boat, or to control a boat with wind power

ex.en: The boat has a large white sail.
ex.zh: 那艘船有一面很大的白帆。

ex.en: The sailors raised the sails at dawn.
ex.zh: 水手們在黎明時升起了帆。

sail.en: a large piece of cloth on a boat that catches the wind to move it

ex.en: Tom bent down and picked up a handful of sand.
ex.zh: 湯姆彎下腰，抓起一把沙子。

ex.en: We found the footprints in the sand.
ex.zh: 我們在沙灘上發現了腳印。

ex.en: Kids are building sand castles on the beach.
ex.zh: 孩子們正在海灘上堆沙堡。

sand.en: tiny grains of rock found on beaches and in deserts

ex.en: Sand the wood before you paint it.
ex.zh: 上漆前先把木頭用砂紙磨過。

ex.en: He sanded the table until it was smooth.
ex.zh: 他把桌子磨到很光滑。

sand.en: to make a surface smooth by rubbing it with rough paper

ex.en: My mother forgot to add salt to the salad.
ex.zh: 我媽媽忘了在沙拉裡加鹽。

ex.en: She discovered that she had run out of salt.
ex.zh: 她發現鹽用完了。

ex.en: Mary puts salt on just about everything she eats.
ex.zh: 瑪莉幾乎吃什麼都要加鹽。

salt.en: a white powder used to give food a stronger taste

ex.en: Tom salted his egg.
ex.zh: 湯姆在蛋上撒了鹽。

ex.en: Salt the water before adding the pasta.
ex.zh: 放義大利麵之前先在水裡加鹽。

salt.en: to add a white powder to food to give it more taste

salt.zh: take … with a grain of salt：對…半信半疑

ex.en: Take his advice with a grain of salt.
ex.zh: 他的建議聽聽就好。

ex.en: I take online reviews with a grain of salt.
ex.zh: 我對網路評論持保留態度。

sake.zh: for the sake of：為了……（的緣故）

ex.en: I stopped smoking for the sake of my health.
ex.zh: 為了健康，我戒菸了。

ex.en: They fought for the sake of their country.
ex.zh: 他們為了國家而戰。

ex.en: Let's stay calm for the sake of the children.
ex.zh: 為了孩子，我們冷靜一點吧。

sake.en: in order to help or get something good

ex.en: My father doesn't drink so much sake.
ex.zh: 我爸爸不太喝清酒。

ex.en: We ordered a bottle of sake with our sushi.
ex.zh: 我們點了一瓶清酒配壽司。

sake.en: a Japanese alcoholic drink made from rice

ex.en: The sailors loaded the cargo onto the ship.
ex.zh: 船員們把貨物裝上船。

ex.en: My uncle worked as a sailor for twenty years.
ex.zh: 我叔叔當了二十年的船員。

sailor.en: a person who works on a ship

ex.en: Please adjust the bike saddle to your height.
ex.zh: 請依你的身高調整腳踏車座墊。

ex.en: He put the saddle on the horse.
ex.zh: 他把馬鞍放到馬背上。

saddle.en: a seat for a rider on a horse or bicycle

ex.en: She saddled him with the work.
ex.zh: 她把這份工作硬塞給他。

ex.en: The company is saddled with huge debts.
ex.zh: 這家公司背負著龐大的債務。

saddle.en: to give someone a heavy job or duty

ex.en: The bargain sale will run for three days, beginning today.
ex.zh: 這次特賣從今天開始，為期三天。

ex.en: I might check for sales or discounts online.
ex.zh: 我可能會上網看看有沒有特價或折扣。

ex.en: The sale prices are written in red ink.
ex.zh: 特價的價格是用紅字寫的。

sale.en: a time when shops sell things at lower prices

ex.en: Sales fell off in the third quarter.
ex.zh: 第三季的銷售額下滑了。

ex.en: Who's in charge of the sales section?
ex.zh: 誰負責業務部門？

sale.en: the act of selling, or the amount that is sold

ex.en: Is this car for sale?
ex.zh: 這輛車要賣嗎？

ex.en: Their house is for sale.
ex.zh: 他們的房子要出售。

ex.en: You can't drink seawater because it is too salty.
ex.zh: 你不能喝海水，因為它太鹹了。

ex.en: This soup is too salty to eat.
ex.zh: 這碗湯太鹹了，喝不下去。

ex.en: This food is too salty.
ex.zh: 這個食物太鹹了。

salty.en: containing or tasting of a lot of the white powder used on food

ex.en: Do you prefer sweet or savory snacks?
ex.zh: 你喜歡甜的還是鹹的點心？

ex.en: The savory pancake was filled with cheese and ham.
ex.zh: 這個鹹煎餅裡夾了起司和火腿。

savory.en: having a pleasant taste that is salty or spicy, not sweet

ex.en: After months of stress, he began to fear for his sanity.
ex.zh: 經過數個月的壓力，他開始擔心自己的精神狀態。

ex.en: Take a break to keep your sanity.
ex.zh: 休息一下，才能保持你的理智。

sanity.en: the state of having a healthy and normal mind

ex.en: Tom is quite sarcastic.
ex.zh: 湯姆真會挖苦人。

ex.en: Don't you think the name "The Sacred War" sounds a bit sarcastic?
ex.zh: 你不覺得這個名字很諷刺嗎，「神聖的戰爭」？

sarcastic.en: saying the opposite of what you mean in order to hurt or joke

ex.en: The nurse cleaned the wound with saline.
ex.zh: 護理師用生理食鹽水清洗傷口。

ex.en: He was given a bag of saline through an IV.
ex.zh: 他打了一袋生理食鹽水點滴。

saline.en: a mix of water and salt used in medicine

ex.en: I use a saline spray when my nose is blocked.
ex.zh: 我鼻塞的時候會用食鹽水噴劑。

ex.en: Contact lenses should be stored in saline solution.
ex.zh: 隱形眼鏡應該泡在食鹽水溶液裡保存。

ex.en: He saluted the lady.
ex.zh: 他向那位女士致意。

ex.en: The soldiers saluted the flag during the ceremony.
ex.zh: 典禮中士兵們向國旗敬禮。

salute.en: to show respect to someone, especially by raising a hand to the head

ex.en: The problem between the two neighbors was settled satisfactorily.
ex.zh: 兩家鄰居之間的問題圓滿解決了。

ex.en: She answered all the interviewer's questions satisfactorily.
ex.zh: 她令人滿意地回答了面試官所有的問題。

satisfactorily.en: in a way that is good enough

ex.en: "God is our salvation," said the priest.
ex.zh: 「天主是我們的救贖。」神父說。

ex.en: For the lonely old man, his dog was his salvation.
ex.zh: 對那位孤單的老人來說，他的狗就是他的救星。

ex.en: Many people turn to religion in search of salvation.
ex.zh: 許多人為了尋求救贖而轉向宗教。

salvation.en: the act of being saved from harm, or a person or thing that saves you

ex.en: Many countries imposed sanctions on the regime.
ex.zh: 許多國家對該政權實施制裁。

ex.en: The sanctions hurt the country's economy.
ex.zh: 這些制裁重創了該國經濟。

sanction.en: a punishment, such as a limit on trade, that countries use against another country

ex.en: It is necessary to obtain the sanction of the authorities to enter this building.
ex.zh: 要進入這棟建築，必須得到主管機關的批准。

ex.en: The plan has the sanction of the board.
ex.zh: 這個計畫獲得了董事會的認可。

ex.en: You should put safety before everything else.
ex.zh: 你應該把安全放在其他一切之上。

ex.en: A bus driver is responsible for the safety of the passengers.
ex.zh: 公車司機要負責乘客的安全。

ex.en: You may injure yourself if you don't follow safety procedures.
ex.zh: 如果不遵守安全程序，你可能會受傷。

safety.en: the state of being protected from danger or harm

ex.en: On the whole I am satisfied with the result.
ex.zh: 總的來說，我對這個結果很滿意。

ex.en: I am not satisfied with the result at all.
ex.zh: 我對這個結果一點兒也不滿意。

ex.en: He was satisfied with the work he had done.
ex.zh: 他對自己的勞動成果很滿意。

satisfied.en: pleased because you have got what you wanted

ex.en: I'd like to open a savings account.
ex.zh: 我想開一個儲蓄帳戶。

ex.en: I put part of my salary into a savings account every month.
ex.zh: 我每個月把部分薪水存進儲蓄帳戶。

savings account.en: a bank account that keeps your money and pays you a little extra

ex.en: No matter what your main purpose is in reading, books should never fail to provide contentment and satisfaction.
ex.zh: 不管讀書的主要目的是什麼，書總能帶給人滿足。

ex.en: I won't give them the satisfaction.
ex.zh: 我不會讓他們稱心如意的。

ex.en: Customer satisfaction is our top priority.
ex.zh: 顧客滿意是我們的首要目標。

satisfaction.en: the pleasant feeling you have when you get what you want

ex.en: Use a formal salutation in the first email.
ex.zh: 第一封電子郵件請使用正式稱呼。

ex.en: The letter begins with the salutation Dear Ms. Chen.
ex.zh: 這封信以「陳小姐您好」作為稱呼。

salutation.en: a word or phrase used to greet someone, such as at the start of a letter

sabbatical.zh: （通常為進修或研究而安排的）長期休假

ex.en: After ten years with the firm, Mei took a sabbatical to complete her research.
ex.zh: 在公司任職十年後，美玲休了長假完成研究。

ex.en: The university offers faculty a sabbatical for study or research.
ex.zh: 這所大學提供教職員進修或研究假。

sabbatical.en: a long period of time away from regular work, often used to study

ex.en: With most households already subscribed, the streaming market is nearing saturation.
ex.zh: 由於多數家庭都已訂閱，串流市場正接近飽和。

ex.zh: 公司再開一家分店前，先透過研究評估市場飽和程度。

saturation.en: the point at which nothing more can be added or taken in

ex.en: His low salary prevents him from buying the house.
ex.zh: 他薪水太低，買不起房子。

ex.en: His high salary enabled him to live in comfort.
ex.zh: 他的高薪讓他生活過得很舒適。

ex.en: I'll pay you back once I receive my salary.
ex.zh: 我一領到薪水就還你錢。

salary.en: money that an employer pays a worker every month

ex.en: Sales rose sharply during the holiday season.
ex.zh: 假期期間銷售額大幅上升。

ex.en: Online sales have grown quickly in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年來網路銷售成長得很快。

ex.en: My brother works in the sales department.
ex.zh: 我哥哥在業務部門工作。

ex.en: She is the new sales manager.
ex.zh: 她是新來的業務經理。

ex.en: Turning off the lights is a simple saving of energy.
ex.zh: 關燈是一種簡單的節能方式。

ex.en: She has some savings for her trip to Japan.
ex.zh: 她有一些存款可以用來去日本旅行。

ex.en: The sale offers a saving of twenty percent.
ex.zh: 這次特賣可以省下百分之二十。

ex.en: Would you like some tomato sauce on your pasta?
ex.zh: 你的義大利麵要不要加一些番茄醬汁？

ex.en: Dip the dumplings in soy sauce.
ex.zh: 把水餃沾醬油吃。

ex.en: She made a spicy sauce for the chicken.
ex.zh: 她為雞肉調了一種辣醬。

ex.en: The mountain is a sacred place for many local people.
ex.zh: 這座山對許多當地人來說是神聖的地方。

ex.zh: 他們一大早就去參拜那座神聖的廟宇。

sacred.zh: 不可侵犯的、極為重要的

ex.en: For her, family time is sacred and never skipped.
ex.zh: 對她來說，家人相處的時間神聖不可侵犯，從不缺席。

ex.en: He treats his promises as sacred.
ex.zh: 他把自己的承諾視為神聖不可違背。

ex.en: Salmon swim up the river to lay their eggs.
ex.zh: 鮭魚逆流而上去產卵。

ex.zh: 我們在釣魚之旅中釣到一條大鮭魚。

ex.en: I ordered grilled salmon with rice for dinner.
ex.zh: 我晚餐點了烤鮭魚配飯。

ex.en: Smoked salmon goes well with bread and cheese.
ex.zh: 燻鮭魚很適合搭配麵包和起司。

ex.en: We usually go hiking on Saturday.
ex.zh: 我們星期六通常會去健行。

ex.zh: 派對星期六晚上七點開始。

ex.en: I sleep late on Saturdays.
ex.zh: 我星期六都睡得很晚。

ex.en: Sarah is a woman mentioned in the Bible.
ex.zh: 莎拉是聖經中提到的一位女性。

ex.zh: 莎拉在英語中也是很受歡迎的女孩名字。

ex.zh: 山姆是塞繆爾或莎曼莎的簡稱。

ex.zh: 山姆為大家帶了零食，在漫長的公車旅程中享用。

san.zh: 聖（用於地名、人名，如 San Francisco）

ex.en: We took a ferry across the bay to San Francisco.
ex.zh: 我們搭渡輪越過海灣去舊金山。

ex.en: The church was named after San Juan, a saint from Spain.
ex.zh: 這間教堂是以來自西班牙的聖人聖胡安命名的。

san.zh: 先生、小姐（日語敬稱，接在名字後）

ex.zh: 在日語裡，你可以稱呼同事為田中先生。

ex.zh: 她禮貌地跟鄰居打招呼說：「早安，佐藤先生。」

ex.zh: 莎莉是莎拉的暱稱。

ex.zh: 在這個故事裡，莎莉每天早上都會遛狗。

ex.en: Saint Patrick is the saint of Ireland.
ex.zh: 聖派翠克是愛爾蘭的守護聖人。

ex.en: The old church was named after a local saint.
ex.zh: 這座老教堂是以當地的一位聖人命名的。

ex.zh: 這個小鎮每年二月都會慶祝聖瓦倫丁節。

ex.zh: 撒母耳是出現在希伯來聖經中的一位先知。

ex.zh: 撒母耳的故事記載在聖經的兩卷書中。

ex.en: My cousin named his baby boy Samuel last spring.
ex.zh: 我表哥去年春天把他的寶寶取名叫塞繆爾。

ex.zh: 塞繆爾在街道對面向我們揮手。

ex.en: Sara is organizing a surprise party for her mother.
ex.zh: 莎拉正在為她媽媽籌辦驚喜派對。

ex.en: Please tell Sara that the meeting starts at ten.
ex.zh: 請告訴莎拉會議十點開始。

ex.en: The children left milk and cookies out for Santa.
ex.zh: 孩子們留了牛奶和餅乾給聖誕老人。

ex.zh: 我爸爸每年平安夜都會扮成聖誕老人。

ex.zh: 她寫了一封信給聖誕老人，希望得到一輛腳踏車。

ex.zh: 最好的朋友搬走時，她藏不住心中的悲傷。

ex.zh: 他說這個故事時，聲音裡帶著深深的悲傷。

ex.zh: 音樂幫助我面對悲傷的情緒。

ex.zh: 星期天我們在後院烤香腸。

ex.zh: 他早餐點了一根香腸和一些蛋。

ex.zh: 我叔叔夏天每個週末都去玩帆船。

ex.zh: 橫越大洋的航行花了船員三個星期。

ex.zh: 那艘船正朝港口航行。

ex.en: They were sailing around the island when the wind picked up.
ex.zh: 他們正環繞島嶼航行時，風勢變強了。

ex.zh: 沙烏地阿拉伯是中東的一個大國。

ex.en: He works for a Saudi company that sells oil.
ex.zh: 他在一家販售石油的沙烏地公司工作。

ex.en: What are you saying? I can't hear you.
ex.zh: 你在說什麼？我聽不到。

ex.en: She kept saying that she was sorry.
ex.zh: 她一直說她很抱歉。

ex.en: There is an old saying that practice makes perfect.
ex.zh: 有句老話說，熟能生巧。

ex.en: My grandmother has a saying for every situation.
ex.zh: 我奶奶對每種情況都有一句俗話。

ex.en: The church offered sanctuary to families who had lost their homes.
ex.zh: 教會為失去家園的家庭提供庇護。

ex.en: Her quiet garden is a sanctuary from the busy city.
ex.zh: 她安靜的花園是遠離繁忙都市的避風港。

ex.en: The bird sanctuary protects rare species near the lake.
ex.zh: 這個鳥類保護區保護湖邊的稀有物種。

ex.en: We visited an elephant sanctuary during our trip.
ex.zh: 我們旅行時參觀了一座大象保護區。

ex.zh: 訪客在寺廟的聖殿內必須保持安靜。

ex.en: The sanctuary of the old church is decorated with gold.
ex.zh: 這座古老教堂的聖所以金色裝飾。

ex.zh: 連下三天大雨後，土壤已經濕透了。

ex.zh: 一直加鹽，直到水達到飽和、再也溶不了為止。

ex.zh: 市場上充斥著便宜的手機殼，已經飽和了。

ex.zh: 這項調查使用隨機抽樣來挑選參與者。

ex.en: Careful sampling of the water showed it was clean.
ex.zh: 仔細取樣檢驗後，顯示這水是乾淨的。

ex.zh: 工廠每小時都會進行取樣。

ex.zh: 我們在日落時沿著一片長長的沙灘散步。

ex.en: The soil here is too sandy for growing rice.
ex.zh: 這裡的土壤沙質太重，不適合種稻。

ex.en: Finishing a long project is very satisfying.
ex.zh: 完成一個長期專案讓人很有成就感。

ex.en: We had a simple but satisfying meal after the hike.
ex.zh: 健行之後我們吃了一頓簡單卻很滿足的飯。

ex.en: I saw a rainbow on my way home yesterday.
ex.zh: 我昨天回家的路上看到了一道彩虹。

ex.en: She saw her old friend at the market.
ex.zh: 她在市場上看到了她的老朋友。

ex.en: Hand me the saw so I can cut this board.
ex.zh: 把鋸子遞給我，我要鋸這塊木板。

ex.zh: 他為自己的工作室買了一把新鋸子。

ex.en: They saw the logs into short pieces for the fire.
ex.zh: 他們把原木鋸成短塊來當柴燒。

ex.en: He sawed a branch off the old tree.
ex.zh: 他從老樹上鋸下一根樹枝。

ex.zh: 用小長柄鍋把牛奶小火加熱。

ex.en: He washed the saucepan and hung it on the wall.
ex.zh: 他洗好長柄鍋，掛到牆上。

saloon.zh: 酒館（美國西部片中常見）

ex.en: The cowboy walked into the saloon and ordered a drink.
ex.zh: 牛仔走進酒館點了一杯飲料。

ex.en: Old western movies often show a fight in a saloon.
ex.zh: 老西部片常出現酒館裡打架的場面。

ex.en: My uncle in London drives a silver saloon.
ex.zh: 我在倫敦的叔叔開一輛銀色轎車。

ex.en: The saloon has more space for luggage than a small hatchback.
ex.zh: 這輛轎車的行李空間比小型掀背車大。

ex.en: She said she would call me tomorrow.
ex.zh: 她說她明天會打電話給我。

ex.en: He said nothing and left the room.
ex.zh: 他什麼也沒說就離開了房間。

ex.zh: 猛烈的暴風雨摧毀了許多房屋。

ex.zh: 那位評論家對這部電影寫了一篇毫不留情的評論。

ex.zh: 報紙對新政策大加撻伐。

ex.en: Critics savaged the film after its release.
ex.zh: 電影上映後遭到影評人猛烈抨擊。

ex.zh: 這本小說是橫跨三代的家族傳奇。

ex.en: He loves fantasy sagas with dragons and kings.
ex.zh: 他喜歡有龍和國王的奇幻長篇故事。

ex.en: The saga of fixing our roof lasted all year.
ex.zh: 修理屋頂的事一波三折，拖了一整年。

ex.en: The long saga with the airline finally ended.
ex.zh: 與航空公司之間冗長的糾紛終於結束了。

ex.en: I wear sandals when it's hot.
ex.zh: 天氣熱時我會穿涼鞋。

ex.en: One of her sandals broke on the beach.
ex.zh: 她的一隻涼鞋在海灘上壞掉了。

ex.en: The villagers asked the old sage for advice.
ex.zh: 村民向那位年長的智者請教。

ex.en: Chicken tastes great when it is cooked with fresh sage.
ex.zh: 雞肉搭配新鮮鼠尾草一起煮，味道很棒。

ex.en: My grandfather gave me some sage advice about money.
ex.zh: 我祖父給了我一些關於金錢的明智建議。

ex.en: It was a sage decision to save some money for emergencies.
ex.zh: 留一些錢應急是個明智的決定。

ex.en: I like to savor my coffee slowly in the morning.
ex.zh: 我喜歡早上慢慢品嚐我的咖啡。

ex.en: Take a moment to savor your success.
ex.zh: 花點時間好好享受你的成功吧。

ex.zh: 這碗湯有濃濃的大蒜與香草風味。

ex.en: Hunger gave the plain bread a special savor.
ex.zh: 飢餓讓普通的麵包格外有滋味。

ex.en: We dipped tortilla chips in fresh tomato salsa.
ex.zh: 我們把玉米片沾上新鮮的番茄莎莎醬。

ex.en: She made a spicy salsa with onions and chili.
ex.zh: 她用洋蔥和辣椒做了辛辣的莎莎醬。

ex.en: They signed up for a salsa class on Friday nights.
ex.zh: 他們報名了週五晚上的騷莎舞課。

ex.en: The band played lively salsa all evening.
ex.zh: 樂團整晚演奏熱情的騷莎音樂。

ex.en: The old sofa began to sag in the middle.
ex.zh: 那張舊沙發中間開始凹陷。

ex.en: The branches sagged under the weight of the snow.
ex.zh: 樹枝被雪的重量壓得下垂。

ex.en: Sales began to sag during the summer months.
ex.zh: 夏季幾個月銷售額開始下滑。

ex.en: His spirits sagged when he heard the bad news.
ex.zh: 聽到壞消息後，他的情緒低落了。

ex.en: The bride wore a dress made of white satin.
ex.zh: 新娘穿著一件白色緞面禮服。

ex.en: Satin feels smooth and slightly cool against the skin.
ex.zh: 緞子貼在皮膚上感覺滑順微涼。

ex.en: She bought a satin ribbon to decorate the gift.
ex.zh: 她買了一條緞帶來裝飾禮物。

ex.en: The pillow has a soft satin cover.
ex.zh: 這個枕頭有柔軟的緞面枕套。

ex.en: The old church was built from local sandstone.
ex.zh: 那座老教堂是用當地的砂岩蓋成的。

ex.en: Wind and rain have slowly carved the sandstone cliffs into strange shapes.
ex.zh: 風雨慢慢把砂岩峭壁雕成奇特的形狀。

ex.zh: 她小心地把杯子放回茶碟上。

ex.en: The cat drank milk from a small saucer.
ex.zh: 貓從一個小碟子裡喝牛奶。

ex.zh: 塞拉耶佛是波士尼亞與赫塞哥維納的首都。

ex.zh: 許多遊客會去參觀塞拉耶佛的老市集。

ex.zh: 報告強調了這項研究最重要的幾個重點。

ex.zh: 這支手機一項顯著的特色是電池續航力很長。

ex.en: After weeks of stress, he wasn't sure he was still sane.
ex.zh: 壓力了好幾週後，他不確定自己是否還神智清楚。

ex.en: A sane person wouldn't swim in that cold river.
ex.zh: 正常人不會去那條冰冷的河裡游泳。

ex.zh: 搬到較小的房子是個明智的選擇。

ex.zh: 她對一個困難的問題給了個理智的回答。

ex.zh: 她有經營成功店面所需的商業頭腦。

ex.zh: 他的政治手腕幫助他贏得了選舉。

ex.zh: 你懂我的意思嗎？

ex.zh: 你懂這台機器是怎麼運作的嗎？

ex.zh: 我的車拋錨時，一位好心的陌生人成了我的救星。

ex.zh: 新來的老師成了這所面臨困境的學校的救星。

ex.zh: 她細細品味每一口蛋糕。

ex.en: Let's savour this moment before we go home.
ex.zh: 回家之前，讓我們好好享受這一刻。

ex.en: He savoured the quiet of the early morning.
ex.zh: 他享受著清晨的寧靜。
